_comment: Run order for agents/content-refresh.mjs. Pages listed here go first, in this order (Phillip, 2026-10-12: Huntsville, Birmingham, termite, Alabaster, Lake Martin). Every page in agents/neuronwriter-targets.json is appended after these, by priority. `figure` is a curated real photo from /public used when the page has no image yet; pages without one get an illustration only when CONTENT_REFRESH_IMAGES=generate. Query IDs are NOT stored here: the agent reuses the newest READY NeuronWriter query for the keyword at run time, so it never spends a new analysis on a keyword that already has one.
